p.text: How did Sarah travel to Samarkand?

fb.correct: 'Yes, I did! I went by train.'
fb.incorrect_default: 'Yes, I did! I went by train.'

fb.correct: 'I did not take my camera — only my phone.'
fb.incorrect_default: 'I did not take my camera — only my phone.'

fb.correct: 'No, I did not. A tourist guide helped me all day.'
fb.incorrect_default: 'No, I did not. A tourist guide helped me all day.'

1.say: Sarah, did you go to Samarkand last week? Yes, I did! I went by train. Did you like it? I loved it. But I did not have much time. How long was the journey? Two hours. Did you go alone? No, I did not. A tourist guide helped me all day.
